name: browser-use
headline: Karem Arabic Presentation - Generate Bilingual
short_description: Generates bilingual Arabic/English HTML presentations with RTL support, animations, and a professional dark theme. Ideal for operations teams creating multilingual presentations. Integrates with Claude Code for automated presentation generation.
author: karem505

sections.overview:
Karem Arabic Presentation is a Claude Code skill that transforms markdown, text, and documents into single-file HTML presentations with full Arabic (RTL) support and bilingual capabilities. It features a professional dark theme with glassmorphism effects, animated counters, and responsive design that works offline without external dependencies. The skill includes templates for common presentation types—title slides, vision/mission, problem/solution timelines, SWOT analysis, product carousels, and statistics displays—all with native Arabic rendering and seamless English technical term integration. Keyboard navigation, progress bars, and scroll-snap transitions provide professional interactivity. Perfect for operations teams, educators, and Arabic-speaking professionals who need stunning visual presentations that handle mixed Arabic/English content.
Creating business plans and pitch decks with Arabic and English content
Generating educational presentations for Arabic-speaking students
Building product showcase carousels with bilingual support
Presenting SWOT analyses and strategic planning documents
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/karem505/karem-arabic-presentation`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a bilingual Arabic/English HTML presentation with RTL support for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. The presentation should include [DATA] and have a professional dark theme with animations. Ensure the content is engaging and suitable for an operations team.
```
